details: Bitcoin experienced a significant price drop, falling to approximately $76,000 on May 18. This downturn followed renewed US-Iran geopolitical tensions, triggered by a statement from Donald Trump, which led to a substantial $722 million in crypto long liquidations across the market.
title: Bitcoin Plunges to $76K Amid US-Iran Tensions & $722M Liquidations

details: Goldman Sachs made a notable shift in its digital asset portfolio during Q1 2026, completely liquidating its positions in XRP and Solana-linked exchange-traded funds. The investment bank also substantially reduced its exposure to Ether ETFs, although it maintained considerable holdings in Bitcoin ETFs.
title: Goldman Sachs Exits XRP & Solana ETFs, Trims BTC/ETH Holdings in Q1

details: MicroStrategy, under the leadership of Michael Saylor, further expanded its Bitcoin treasury by acquiring an additional 24,869 BTC for approximately $2.01 billion. These purchases, made between May 11 and May 17 at an average price of $80,985 per coin, bring the company's total Bitcoin holdings to 843,738 BTC.
title: MicroStrategy Adds 24,869 BTC for $2.01B, Total Holdings Reach 843,738 BTC

details: Iran has introduced "Hormuz Safe," a new Bitcoin-backed insurance service for shipping companies operating through the Strait of Hormuz. This initiative, reported by state-affiliated media, aims to generate over $10 billion in revenue by offering cryptographically verifiable insurance policies settled in Bitcoin.
title: Iran Launches Bitcoin-Backed Shipping Insurance for Strait of Hormuz

details: The US Senate Banking Committee has advanced the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act. This legislation seeks to establish a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies and stablecoins in the United States, marking a significant step towards achieving clearer crypto regulation.
title: US Senate Banking Committee Advances Digital Asset Market Clarity Act
